name: Contains Role
description: An IAM instance profile contains the IAM role it passes to an EC2 instance (instance profile -> role), as ListInstanceProfiles reports it in the profile's Roles. A profile holds at most one role. A reference, not containment: the role exists, with its own trust policy and permissions, whether or not a profile holds it. Emitted whether or not the role was collected: it resolves by deterministic identity (the role ARN) when it is.
